name: zmodel_fog_set_enabled
description: zModel_Fog_SetEnabled stores the fog enabled flag and makes it visible to the recovered fog getter.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this zModel fog getter/setter cluster; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zModel fog source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x476170 stores ECX directly to gModel_FogEnabled and returns.
The native zRndr/zModel fog smoke verifies enabled and disabled values through both gModel_FogEnabled and zModel_Fog_IsEnabled using production code.
